commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' A player from Brighton commits a rough challenge. David Coote blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
90+2' Mikey Moore (Tottenham) takes the corner which is cleared.
90+1' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball goes out of play. Tottenham are awarded a corner kick.
90+1' A pass by Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' Here is a change. Yankuba Minteh is going off and Fabian Hurzeler gives the last tactical orders to Brajan Gruda (Brighton).
87' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) but poses no threat.
86' Mikey Moore (Tottenham) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
85' The substitution has been made. Mikey Moore (Tottenham) has replaced James Maddison.
85' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Julio Enciso (Brighton), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

84' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Bart Verbruggen leaps like a salmon to deny him.
82' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) makes a strong challenge and David Coote blows for a foul. Tottenham are awarded a free kick.
80' Booking. Bart Verbruggen (Brighton) receives a caution from the referee.
79' Ange Postecoglou prepares a substitution. Timo Werner is replaced by Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham).
79' Substitution. Rodrigo Bentancur is replaced by Yves Bissouma (Tottenham).
79' Timo Werner (Tottenham) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
79' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.

75' The game is interrupted. Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Brighton are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
74' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mats Wieffer (Brighton) replacing Carlos Baleba.
74' The substitution is prepared. Julio Enciso (Brighton) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Georginio Rutter.
73' Timo Werner (Tottenham) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
72' The resulting set piece from Tottenham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
72' James Maddison (Tottenham) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball goes behind for a corner. Tottenham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
71' Tottenham work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

71' Timo Werner (Tottenham) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick.
70' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brighton, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
69' The foul by Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by David Coote.
69' A direct free kick from a promising position, taken by Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton), is struck into one of the defending players who deals with the threat.
67' David Coote shows a yellow card to Destiny Udogie (Tottenham), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
66' 3 - 2 Goal! Danny Welbeck (Brighton) makes the score 3:2 after burying a close-range header in the middle of the goal after a good run and cross by Georginio Rutter.
63' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
62' He should have scored! Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
61' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) commits a foul during an attacking move.
61' Joel Veltman (Brighton) commits a rough challenge and David Coote blows his whistle for a foul. Tottenham earn a free kick.
61' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.

58' 2 - 2 GOAL! Superb work from Kaoru Mitoma, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Georginio Rutter (Brighton), who beats Guglielmo Vicario with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 2:2.
58' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Bart Verbruggen intercepts the ball.
58' Timo Werner (Tottenham) takes a short corner kick.
57' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham). Tottenham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

57' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Guglielmo Vicario makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
56' Brighton failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

56' Joel Veltman (Brighton) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Brighton.
53' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is flagged for offside.
53' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) works the corner short.
52' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
48' 1 - 2 Goal! Kaoru Mitoma sends a precise cross into the box, Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) latches on to it and puts the ball into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:2.
47' James Maddison (Tottenham) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
46' Carlos Baleba (Brighton) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Tottenham.
46' The game is over for Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton). Pervis Estupinan comes on for the second half.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Flag up against Georginio Rutter (Brighton). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
45+1' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball goes out of play and Brighton will have a goal kick.
43' The foul by Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) was seen by David Coote who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Tottenham win a free kick.
41' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
40' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) latched on to a lofted pass inside the box, but his header misses to the right of the target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
40' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
37' 0 - 2 Goal! Timo Werner plays a pass to the feet of James Maddison (Tottenham), and he shoots into the bottom right corner from inside the box. It's 0:2.
37' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
36' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
34' Igor (Brighton) sees a yellow card from David Coote after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

32' CHANCE! Danny Welbeck (Brighton) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he sends his shot well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
31' A lofted cross from Timo Werner (Tottenham) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
29' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) sends a chip pass into the box, but Guglielmo Vicario is quickest to intercept the ball.
23' 0 - 1 Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a clinical finish!
23' After what seems an eternity, referee David Coote decides NO GOAL for Tottenham after the VAR review! Play to continue.
23' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee David Coote is going to take a look using VAR.
22' Timo Werner (Tottenham) has a goal ruled out for offside!
20' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when David Coote blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Brighton.
20' Timo Werner (Tottenham) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball. Brighton have a free kick.
18' Timo Werner (Tottenham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
18' David Coote interrupts the game. One of the players from Brighton won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. A free kick has been awarded to Tottenham.

17' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brighton.
16' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
15' Rough tackle by Georginio Rutter (Brighton). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Tottenham have a free kick.
13' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
13' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) jumps into a tackle and David Coote signals a foul. It's a free kick to Brighton in a dangerous position.
12' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
12' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
11' Dangerous play by Carlos Baleba (Brighton). David Coote blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Tottenham.
9' Fabian Hurzeler is forced to make a change. Adam Webster is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Igor (Brighton).
7' Adam Webster (Brighton) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
6' James Maddison (Tottenham) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
5' A decent cross into the box is met first time by James Maddison (Tottenham), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Good work from Tottenham as they win a corner.
4' Tottenham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
3' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Tottenham are awarded a corner kick.
3' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
2' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
1' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Tottenham was in an offside position.
1' The match has just started.
Brighton will kick the game off.
